train_semantic_segmentation_model: run the semantic segmentation training loop with configurable epochs, batch size, and learning rate via CLI args
validate_semseg_model: validate a semantic segmentation model on a DataLoader and return per-batch losses and accuracies
get_loss: compute masked NLL loss for semantic segmentation predictions sampling empty voxels with configurable probability
get_accuracy: calculate classification accuracy by comparing predicted class indices against ground truth labels
train_epoch: train one epoch of a semantic segmentation model returning per-batch losses and accuracies
